# =====================================================================
# CWIC Super Event System  (auto-generated helper effects)
# Central logic for logging super events to a "Latest News" array and
# applying player popup-filter preferences. Fire sites now call
# CWIC_Show_Super_Event instead of setting CWIC_Super_Event_Visible directly.
# =====================================================================

# Called (inside every_country, ROOT = source country) at each super event fire.
CWIC_Show_Super_Event = {
	CWIC_Resolve_Current_SE = yes      # figure out which event this is -> CWIC_se_current (id)
	CWIC_Log_Current_SE = yes          # record it in the last-10 news log
	if = {
		limit = { CWIC_should_show_super_event = yes }
		set_country_flag = CWIC_Super_Event_Visible
	}
	else = {
		# player filtered this one out: don't leave its picture flag hanging
		CWIC_Clear_All_SE_Flags = yes
	}
}

# Append current event id to the news log (newest first), keeping only the last 10.
# Skips if this event is already the newest entry (an event firing in several
# countries calls this once per country, which would otherwise duplicate it).
CWIC_Log_Current_SE = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { CWIC_se_current > 0 }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { CWIC_se_log^num = 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { CWIC_se_log^0 = CWIC_se_current } }
			}
		}
		add_to_array = { array = CWIC_se_log value = CWIC_se_current index = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { CWIC_se_log^num > 10 } }
			remove_from_array = { array = CWIC_se_log index = 10 }
		}
	}
}

CWIC_Resolve_Current_SE = {
	set_variable = { CWIC_se_current = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = Super_Event_JAP_Economic_Dominance_visible } set_variable = { CWIC_se_current = 1 } }

# Reopen a past super event from the Latest News list (bypasses filters; player clicked it).
